messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick q — planning a small 'Thank-a-Teammate' postcard + enamel pin drop for Q2 kudos. Can we ship physical postcards to distributed folks? Need volunteers for address pull + packaging ~200 envelopes. Timeline: print by Wed, ship Fri. Any blockers?
Jamal: I'm in for packaging on Fri morning. Who owns the master addresses and labels? Also budget?
Olivia: There's a CSV in Confluence I can export: https://redwood.atlassian.net/.../thank-a-teammate-addresses.csv — I can pull it. Budget looks ok: pins ~$2.50 ea (200 -> $500), printing ~$120.
Sam: Can we use people-ops-bot to export? e.g. `people-ops-bot export_addresses --list thank-a-teammate`
PeopleOps Bot: Export ready — /tmp/thankateam_2026-03-20.csv (200 rows).
Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Jamal + Sam — can you own packaging + drop at UPS hub? Olivia — can you confirm print vendor and get a print proof by Tue EOD? I'll book prepaid label batch once we have final CSV.
Jamal: I can do the drop. Sam can you handle labels script and the UPS manifest? What time Fri works for packing?
Sam: 9:30am at the Berkeley office works for me. I'll bring tape, scales, and the label printer. I'll run: `python tools/label_batch.py --csv /tmp/thankateam_2026-03-20.csv --out labels.csv`
Olivia: Requested proof from StickyPrints — expect by Mon 5pm. If they miss it we'll fall back to local print shop.
Maya (People Ops): :thumbsup: I'll submit a Jira expense: Pins $500, Printing $120, Labels/supplies $30 = ~$650. Tagging finance — @Arun (Finance).
Arun (Finance): Approve pending vendor invoice and final receipts. Please CC finance@redwood on the purchase order.
Jamal: Note — international addresses need customs forms. Sam can you flag those rows in the CSV so we can handle them separately?
Sam: Will add an `intl` column and filter. Also will generate `UPS_bulk_manifest.csv` for the hub.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled — Packaging crew meeting Fri 09:30. Calendar invite sent to Maya, Jamal, Sam, Olivia.
Maya (People Ops): One last Q — handwritten note or printed generic message? Handwritten is lovely but might slow us down.
Olivia: Recommend short printed note with a signature line: "Thanks for bringing your A-game to Redwood — Maya on behalf of Redwood Inference." Faster and consistent.
Jamal: :party_parrot: Printed note sounds great.
Maya (People Ops): Awesome — action items recap: Olivia confirm proof by Tue EOD; PeopleOps Bot export confirmed; Sam prepare label script + manifest; Jamal lead drop + packaging; Maya will order printed notes + pins and submit expense. Anyone else want to join packaging? Sign up: https://docs.google.com/forms/packaging-signup
Sam: I'll add the packaging checklist to the shared drive: `drive.redwood/ops/thank-a-teammate/checklist.md`
Olivia: Proof requested — vendor replied that the artwork looks good, awaiting confirmation on paper stock.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team! If no other blockers I'll proceed with PO and booking.
Jamal: Thanks — see you Fri 9:30.
Olivia: Thanks all.
Arun (Finance): Noted — finance will watch for invoice.
